main_text.p: te, quæ est facultas rationalis; Hinc pravas cogitationes non potuisse expiari nisi holocausto, quod sacrificium erat nobilissimum, sicut refert Rabbi Bechai fol.137. col.1. Holocaustum non offerebatur pro peccato externo, sed tantum pro peccaminosis cogitationibus & animi motibus, à quibus nemo hominum liber est.
main_text.head: CAPUT XI.
De libero Arbitrio Hominis Peccatoris.

p.i: Judæos Recentiores omnes Religionis, Salutisque suæ principium constituere, tum in promissionibus, absolutaque divina Misericordia, absque peccatorum satisfactione per alium præstita, tum in ipso homine, ejusque יהוה Electione, absolutisque liberi arbitrii viribus, extra omnem positum est controversiam, cū nonsolum illud quotidie in familiaribus testentur colloquiis, valdeque urgeant, si nobiscum disputent, verum abunde etiam pateat,

page.notes: Initial "J" is a large woodcut-style letter; Hebrew word in the text is printed as shown and was read with some uncertainty. Heading "De libero Arbitrio Hominis Peccatoris" set in italic display type. Some words in the first paragraph are faded and were read with care.
